description: Shared RAGuard question set for all stages, over the synthetic sample documents (scripts/make_sample_docs.py). modality: text = answerable from text-layer pages (Stage 1+); ocr / visual = need Stage 2; none = unanswerable from the documents. key_facts: every fact must appear in the answer for it to count as correct; alternatives are separated by '|'.

questions.question: What minimum attendance is required to write the end-semester examination?
questions.expected_answer: At least 75% attendance in each course.

questions.question: Can a student with 70% attendance apply for condonation, and on what grounds?
questions.expected_answer: Yes: students with 65-75% attendance may apply for condonation on medical grounds with a medical certificate.

questions.question: How much is the condonation fee?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 500 per course.

questions.question: Within how many days must the medical certificate be submitted?
questions.expected_answer: Within 7 days of returning to classes.

questions.question: What happens if a student's attendance in a course is below 65%?
questions.expected_answer: They are not eligible for condonation and must re-register for the course in a later semester.

questions.question: To whom should the medical certificate for condonation be submitted?
questions.expected_answer: The Head of Department.

questions.question: What are the conditions for being eligible to write end-semester exams?
questions.expected_answer: Meet the attendance requirement, have no pending library dues, and register through the student portal before the deadline.

questions.question: How are the 40 continuous internal evaluation marks distributed?
questions.expected_answer: Internal test 1: 15, internal test 2: 15, assignments/quizzes: 10.

questions.question: What are the pass criteria for a theory course?
questions.expected_answer: At least 40% in the end-semester exam and at least 50% in the aggregate of CIE and ESE.

questions.question: In which week is the second internal test conducted?
questions.expected_answer: Week 12.

questions.question: What is the penalty for submitting the project report late?
questions.expected_answer: 10% of the project marks per week of delay.

questions.question: In what form must final-year project reports be submitted?
questions.expected_answer: Two hard copies and one soft copy (PDF).

questions.question: What topics are covered in Unit 3 of CS201?
questions.expected_answer: Binary trees, traversals, binary search trees, AVL trees and rotations, heaps and priority queues.

questions.question: Which shortest path algorithm is taught in the graphs unit of CS201?
questions.expected_answer: Dijkstra's algorithm.

questions.question: What is the prerequisite for CS201 Data Structures?
questions.expected_answer: CS101 Programming Fundamentals.

questions.question: How many lab experiments must a student complete to sit the CS201 lab examination?
questions.expected_answer: At least 8 of the 10 experiments.

questions.question: How are the 25 lab marks for CS201 split?
questions.expected_answer: 15 marks for weekly records and 10 marks for the final lab examination.

questions.question: What is the last date to submit the online application for B.Tech admission?
Which documents must be produced at the time of admission?
questions.expected_answer: Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, transfer certificate, community certificate (if claiming reservation), two photographs, proof of fee payment and a government photo ID.

questions.question: Compare the project submission deadline in the academic regulations with the one in the admission notice.
questions.expected_answer: The regulations say two weeks before the end-semester exams; the admission notice says 15 April 2027 for the 2026-27 batch. They differ.

questions.question: When do the hostel gates close?
questions.expected_answer: 9:30 PM on all days.

questions.question: When are visitors allowed in the hostel?
questions.expected_answer: Only on Sundays between 10 AM and 5 PM.

questions.question: According to the grade distribution chart, which grade was most common and what share of students got it?
questions.expected_answer: Grade A, 26% of students.
